plan.reason: With only 24/100 evaluations used and heavy stagnation (23), the current plan is over-exploiting too early. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic as data accumulates; slight exploration increase (0.2->0.45) encourages novelty in the 5-D space while keeping local refinement modest. current_to_best retains convergence pressure; small population and generations keep surrogate cost low within the fixed budget.
